entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! This is absolutely ridiculous. I bought a jersey from you people and it's completely useless to me. I want my money back, now!
I'm very sorry to hear you're unhappy with your purchase, sir. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you provide me with your order number?
It's VF-8675309. And you'd better be able to do something. This jersey is the wrong size, it's way too tight. It's unwearable. I expect a full refund or an exchange immediately.
Thank you for that, order VF-8675309. I'm pulling it up now. I see the Pro-Cycle Jersey was delivered to you on September 27th.

I don't care when it was delivered! Are you going to help me or are you going to waste my time? I'm one click away from leaving a review that will make sure no one ever buys from you again. Do I need to speak to your manager?

There's no need for that, sir, I can absolutely help you. I was just confirming the details. Since the issue is that the jersey is too tight, I can confirm you're well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely process this for you.
Well, of course it's within the window. So what's the solution? Are you sending me a label or not?
Yes, absolutely. Since you mentioned wanting to exchange it because it was the wrong size, I can start that process, or I can issue a return for a full refund. Which would you prefer?
Fine. Just give me the refund. I'll handle reordering it myself. I don't trust you to get the exchange right.

I understand. I have initiated the return for a full refund. You will receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions on how to send the jersey back to us. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Alright. Make sure that email actually shows up.
It has already been sent and should be in your inbox within the next 5-10 minutes. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
